items.text: New England (Wed report + Thu update; Munich): OUT - RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness), C/G Ben Brown (knee), CB Carlton Davis III (knee); none traveled to Germany. Wed DNP - RB Rhamondre Stevenson (knee), TE Cameron Latu (back), OL Walter Rouse (concussion), S Brenden Schooler (hamstring). Wed limited - WR A.J. Brown (ankle/knee, first practice since late Oct; traveled, no final decision), S Kevin Byard (chest), TE Hunter Henry (foot), RT Morgan Moses (foot), OL Greg Van Roten (hamstring), CB Charles Woods (hamstring), FB Reggie Gilliam (knee, IR window). Thursday (walk-through in Germany): several upgraded to limited; A.J. Brown and Stevenson reported on track to play. LT Will Campbell not on the injury report. Drake Maye (right shoulder) full, starts.
items.source: Patriots.com (Week 10 injury report, Nov 11) / The Grey Manes (Thursday report, Nov 12)

items.text: Detroit (Thursday report): OUT - S Kerby Joseph (knee; full in practice but not activated, did not travel), CB D.J. Reed (hip), C Cade Mays (ankle). DNP - RB Sione Vaki (ankle). Limited - WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib). Full - S Brian Branch (hip), EDGE DJ Wonnum (concussion), RB Jacob Saylors (neck/hamstring). IR - LB Jack Campbell, CB Thomas Harper, RB Isiah Pacheco. QB Jared Goff (chest) limited Wed, listed limited/full Thu in reports, not on out list; Goff expected to start.
items.source: Sports Illustrated / Lions On SI (Week 10 Thursday injury report, Nov 12)
